items.title: Rockstar saca la motosierra y tumba un proyecto para llevar GTA 6 a PC. Su autor no tenía edad ni de votar
items.description:
Aunque los jugadores de PS5 y Xbox Series X|S llevan casi una semana disfrutando
de GTA 6, los usuarios de PC aún tendrán que esperar para echarle el guante al
nuevo mundo abierto de Rockstar. Por ahora, y siguiendo la tónica general del
estudio, no tenemos fecha de lanzamiento para una posible versión para
ordenadores, pero, con el auge de la IA y los esfuerzos de determinados usuarios
por piratear las consolas de Sony, muchos hackers se han puesto manos a la obra
para desarrollar un port no oficial para ordenadores. Sin embargo, como cabía
esperar, Rockstar y Take-Two han intervenido y han tumbado uno de estos
proyectos, curiosamente liderado por un chaval de 15 años. Según ha recogido The
Verge, el proyecto, bautizado como Project Leonida, nació gracias a una supuesta
filtración de una versión jugable para XBOX. La idea, según menciona el medio
anglosajón, era recurrir a la IA para facilitar la decompilación del código a
partir del ejecutable y su posterior adaptación para conseguir que el juego
funcionase de forma nativa en Windows. Un proceso costoso en el que, gracias a
la democratización de las herramientas de IA, se han logrado avances
significativos, algo que Rockstar temía ya desde antes de lanzar GTA 6. Esta
carrera contrarreloj para llevar el juego a PC de forma no oficial ha llevado a
muchos modders a organizarse para trabajar conjuntamente y tratar de ser los
primeros. Aunque parece que hay más grupos, Take-Two ya ha estrechado el cerco
sobre uno de ellos. Como mencionábamos, la compañía estadounidense ha presentado
una solicitud de retirada de contenido por infracción de derechos de autor
contra Project Leonida en GitHub y más de 2.900 repositorios derivados del
proyecto. Según argumenta Take-Two, este proyecto "infringe los derechos de
autor de Take-Two y facilita la infracción de los derechos de autor del título
de Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI". Asimismo, el servidor de Discord en
torno al cual se organizaba la comunidad también ha desaparecido. El creador del
port de GTA 6 para PC tiene 15 años y ha decidido abandonar Tras la desaparición
del proyecto, su principal responsable, conocido en redes sociales como
NotRexed, ha anunciado que abandona definitivamente esta iniciativa. Eso sí,
como ha explicado el propio joven en Twitter (el post ha sido eliminado), las
acciones legales de Rockstar y Take-Two no han sido el único motivo detrás de su
decisión. "Como ya he dicho antes, soy un chico de 15 años. Compaginar los
estudios y el deporte ya es bastante complicado sin tener a hombres de mediana
edad gritándote y quejándose en Discord. Adiós", ha comentado el modder, quien
también ha compartido una captura de pantalla en la que se le informa de que su
cuenta de Discord ha sido suspendida hasta 2028. En 3D Juegos Guía completa de
GTA 6, todas las misiones, coleccionables, armas, vehículos, trucos, secretos y
consejos para completar el juego al 100% Aun así, y pese a la desaparición de
Leonida, la comunidad no ha tirado la toalla. The Verge ha destacado que hay
varios proyectos independientes que persiguen el mismo objetivo, entre ellos
VIctory, aunque todavía están lejos de ofrecer una experiencia jugable. Y es
que, por mucho que la inteligencia artificial pueda agilizar determinadas tareas
de ingeniería inversa y recompilación, conseguir que un videojuego de semejante
envergadura funcione de forma nativa en PC no es tarea fácil. Ya a la venta la
revista Grand Theft Auto - La saga al completo Nos alegra mucho anunciar que
3DJuegos ha estrenado su primera revista de papel, y tiene como protagonista a
la saga Grand Theft Auto. Se trata de un magazine de 164 páginas con calidad
premium en el que vas a encontrar artículos y análisis de todos los juegos que
forman parte de la exitosa serie de Rockstar, desde sus inicios en la primera
PlayStation y PC, hasta el más reciente GTA 6. Puedes comprar la revista al
precio de 9,99 euros,  desde este mismo enlace, y la puedes comprar también en
GAME a través de su web oficial. Se trata de una edición limitada, ¡así que date
prisa y no te quedes sin ella! Revista Grand Theft Auto - La saga al completo.
Ed. Limitada 9,99 € Game — 9,99 € El precio podría variar. Obtenemos comisión
por estos enlaces En 3DJuegos | ¿Es posible rescatar Mass Effect y Dragon Age
aunque a Electronic Arts no le interese? En 3DJuegos | CD Projekt tiene una
línea roja que no piensa cruzar con The Witcher 4, da igual cuántos millones de
jugadores haya esperando - La noticia Rockstar saca la motosierra y tumba un
proyecto para llevar GTA 6 a PC. Su autor no tenía edad ni de votar fue
publicada originalmente en 3DJuegos por Alberto Lloria .

items.description:
El Black Friday es uno de los mejores momentos del año para comprar un nuevo
móvil, renovar nuestro armario o, claro está, lanzarnos a por ofertas gaming.
Todos los años encontramos videojuegos con descuento, así como periféricos,
portátiles gaming o incluso dispositivos de realidad virtual. Ahora bien, la
clave está en no mirar solo una o dos tiendas: es importante conocer y bichear
las máximas posibles. Una opción que merece la pena revisar es Facilitea, una
tienda online con ofertas exclusivas para clientes de CaixaBank. Esta también
está de Black Friday este mes, aunque solo hasta el próximo 29 de noviembre. Ahí
hay varias opciones para los que somos gamers, con consolas o periféricos

items.title: Se lanzó hace 7 años, rinde homenaje a clásicos de terror y ahora regresa de la mejor forma posible. Song of Horror quiere paralizarte con su nueva edición
items.description:
Los fans del terror tendrán una nueva oportunidad para adentrarse en un universo
oscuro, enigmático y cuya historia es capaz de poner los pelos de punta a más de
un jugador. Protocol Games y Meridiem han anunciado Song of Horror: Enhanced
Edition, una nueva versión del título original de 2019 que mejora la
escalofriante experiencia de terror psicológico con un apartado visual más
detallado, una atmósfera aún más inquietante, ajustes que refinan la aventura en
general y mucho más. Ahora bien, hay un detalle que los desarrolladores no han
tocado: La Presencia sigue aquí y sus encuentros serán más terroríficos que
nunca. El escritor Sebastian P. Husher ha desaparecido sin dejar rastro alguno y
su familia también se ha desvanecido por completo. Con el objetivo de llevar a
cabo una investigación rutinaria, 13 personajes diferentes empiezan a indagar en
el caso iniciando así un viaje aterrador en el que no falta la exploración, los
rompecabezas y los descubrimientos que pondrían a prueba la cordura del más
sensato. Ahora bien, nada de esto se compara con las consecuencias de tener un
encuentro con La Presencia; una entidad eterna y oscura, cuya existencia desafía
toda lógica, que parece estar detrás de las misteriosas desapariciones. Una de
las características más interesantes de Song of Horror es que los 13 personajes
son muy distintos entre sí. "Algunos desvelarán secretos sobre los que otros no
saben nada. Otros estarán mejor preparados para confrontar fenómenos
sobrenaturales", se lee en la ficha del juego en Steam. En otras palabras, cada
uno de estos protagonistas contribuye a la investigación de forma diferente en
función de sus habilidades y comportamientos. Sin embargo, Protocol Games
recuerda que "ninguno de ellos está a salvo de La Presencia". Las mejoras de
Song of Horror: Enhanced Edition Conservando dicha historia, Protocol Games ha
decidido trabajar nuevamente en Song of Horror para preparar una experiencia aún
más escalofriante para los jugadores. En este sentido, la Enhanced Edition se
beneficiará de las capacidades gráficas de Unreal Engine 5 añadiendo asimismo un
rediseño completo de las animaciones y el sistema de gestos de los personajes,
nuevos efectos visuales, niebla volumétrica, texturas y sombreadores revisados,
y más. Eso sí, el trabajo de Protocol Games no se limita solamente a lo visual.
En este sentido, los jugadores notarán un rendimiento optimizado, ajustes en los
encuentros con La Presencia, rompecabezas rediseñados (sin sacrificar su
dificultad original), una exploración más accesible, múltiples cinemáticas
recreadas y animadas de cero, y otros detalles que, en conjunto, mejoran la
experiencia general de Song of Horror. La nueva versión ya está en camino y se
hará de rogar, pues sus desarrolladores aseguran que su lanzamiento está
previsto para octubre de 2027. Aun así, se trata de una gran oportunidad para
(re)descubrir una joya del género y una experiencia que rinde homenaje a los
clásicos de terror psicológico. En 3DJuegos | La nominación a GOTY de GTA VI ha
confundido a muchos jugadores. La mayoría de lectores de 3DJuegos creen que
Geoff Keighley pudo haberlo hecho mejor En 3DJuegos | Crear algunos de los
mejores JRPG de la historia tiene un precio. Atlus avisa sobre sus planes con
Persona, y hay algo que me preocupa - La noticia Se lanzó hace 7 años, rinde
homenaje a clásicos de terror y ahora regresa de la mejor forma posible. Song of
Horror quiere paralizarte con su nueva edición fue publicada originalmente en
3DJuegos por Brenda Giacconi .

items.title: Nintendo adds eight remixed tracks and two rallies to Mario Kart World
items.description:
Nintendo released the free version 1.9.0 update for Mario Kart World on Nintendo
Switch 2 on November 24. It adds eight remixed versions of existing courses, two
Knockout Tour routes and automatic race and battle replays. Players can race on
the course variants in VS Race, Time Trials and online or wireless races. The
new routes, Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally, unlock after players complete at
least one Knockout Tour rally. The update also adjusts parts of several routes,
changes item probabilities and fixes gameplay issues, including cases where
racers crashed without hitting obstacles or could not jump in certain areas.
Nintendo says more Knockout Tour routes are planned for future updates. Some
players, however, have been asking for new tracks and paid downloadable content
rather than remixes of familiar courses. Highlights: Route details: Feather
Rally connects Mario Bros. Circuit to Boo Cinema, while Lucky Cat Rally links
Great Question Block Ruins with Sky-High Sundae. Replay limits: The game
automatically saves recent races and battles, deletes the oldest replays when
storage fills, and does not preserve replays from version 1.8.0 or earlier.
Online missions: Players can now drive over P Switches to start Free Roam
missions during online, wireless and LAN play, but not in two-player play or
events. Course changes: The remixes include routes that can run in the opposite
direction. The update also opens river sections on five routes toward Cheep
Cheep Falls. Perspectives: Nintendo Wire argued that the update gives players
more to do in a game it described as already packed with content. (Nintendo
Wire) Sources: Mario Kart World Version 1.9.0 adds 8 remixed courses, 2 Knockout
Tour routes and more - mynintendonews.com Mario Kart World version 1.9.0 update

Nintendo released the free version 1.9.0 update for Mario Kart World on Nintendo
Switch 2 on November 24. It adds eight remixed versions of existing courses, two
Knockout Tour routes and automatic race and battle replays. Players can race on
the course variants in VS Race, Time Trials and online or wireless races. The
new routes, Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally, unlock after players complete at
least one Knockout Tour rally. The update also adjusts parts of several routes,
changes item probabilities and fixes gameplay issues, including cases where
racers crashed without hitting obstacles or could not jump in certain areas.
Nintendo says more Knockout Tour routes are planned for future updates. Some
players, however, have been asking for new tracks and paid downloadable content
rather than remixes of familiar courses.

items.title: Sony secures marketing role for Polish studio's Witcher 4, targeted for 2028
items.description:
Polish game developer CD Projekt Red signed a marketing partnership with Sony
Interactive Entertainment on Nov. 24 to promote its upcoming role-playing game
The Witcher 4, which the studio is targeting for release in 2028. The agreement
also covers the availability of CD Projekt Red games on PlayStation and in
PlayStation Plus, Sony’s subscription service, but the companies have not
announced which games will be included or how the campaign will work. The
marketing arrangement does not make The Witcher 4 a PlayStation exclusive: CD
Projekt Red expects to release the game on PC and Xbox Series X/S as well as
PlayStation 5. Chief Financial Officer Piotr Nielubowicz told investors the
cooperation would support the company’s business and financial outlook this year
and in coming years. Highlights: Studio staffing: As of October, CD Projekt Red
employed 1,051 people, with slightly fewer than half working on The Witcher 4.
Development costs: The company’s development spending rose from $282.38 million
at the end of 2025 to $417.05 million by Sept. 30, 2026, driven mainly by The
Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2 and a Witcher 3 expansion. Story link: The upcoming
Witcher 3 expansion is intended to connect its story with The Witcher 4. Trilogy
plan: The Witcher 4 is the first game in a planned new trilogy, which CD Projekt
Red has said it aims to release within six years. Sources: PlayStation secures

items.title: CD Projekt Red expects Witcher 4 to rival GTA 6's technical leap
items.description:
CD Projekt Red joint CEO Michał Nowakowski says the studio expects The Witcher 4
to make a leap comparable to the one from Grand Theft Auto 5 to Grand Theft Auto
6. He said the studio is developing the new Witcher game 11 years after The
Witcher 3, aiming for significantly better visuals and improvements across
“pretty much every possible facet”. Nowakowski said GTA 6 has not changed the
studio’s ambitions or development budgets for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2. He
described those projects as driven by ambition, not fixed spending limits. The
Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release, and CD Projekt Red says it will use its
own marketing approach rather than copy Rockstar’s. Highlights: Console

studio’s ambitions or development budgets for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2. He

industry, and in terms of game sales, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led the

items.title: Just Like GTA 6, The Witcher 4 Has A PlayStation Deal
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has announced that just today, November 24, the Polish studio
signed new deals with Sony Interactive Entertainment for The Witcher 4's
upcoming marketing campaign, among other efforts. CFO Piotr Nielubowicz told
investors that the deals cover CD Projekt Red's games on PlayStation and in the
PlayStation Plus catalog, as well as "our collaboration during the upcoming
Witcher 4 marketing campaign." “This cooperation will support our business and
financial outlook in this and future years," he said, according to VGC.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54dabgZJ5YA No specifics were made available,
but the partnership for The Witcher 4's marketing campaign has people theorizing
that it could be similar to Rockstar's co-marketing deal with Sony for GTA 6.
Under that agreement, GTA 6 was marketed as a game that "plays best on PS5,"
even if the jury is out on that being true. Sony also created special GTA 6
DualSense controllers and even custom consoles for NBA players. The PlayStation
branding was prioritized over Xbox to give people the impression that they
should get it on PlayStation. The Witcher 4 is in the works now and is expected
to launch in 2028 for console and PC. The game kicks off a new trilogy of The
Witcher games, which will also include The Witcher 5 and The Witcher 6. These
will all be released within a six-year window, so the whole new trilogy could be
out by 2034. The studio is “targeting” a 2028 release for The Witcher 4, so it
could be delayed like The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 were before it.

items.title: GTA 6 players unlock portal to original 2002 Vice City
items.description:
A newly solved Grand Theft Auto 6 secret takes players through a portal into a
recreation of the original 2002 Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, then rewards them
with Tommy Vercetti’s shirt and a motorcycle. Creator Memeio uncovered the
puzzle and shared the solution publicly on Nov. 23. Players activate a radio
tower in Key Lento, then visit 12 Leonida Power and Light substations in a
precise sequence before heading to Reactor 2 at the T.H. Power Station at night
in the game. The retro section recreates the older game’s low-resolution,
low-polygon look and includes Kent Paul, voiced again by Danny Dyer. Highlights:
Three-day search: Memeio said he spent three days following power lines and
searching for the substations. Cheat-code clue: The letters on the stations
spell “Life Is Passing Me By,” a Vice City cheat code that accelerates the
in-game clock. Sequence rules: Fast travel and switching characters can reset
the puzzle, while trespassing at staffed stations may draw police. Jason twist:
In the retro sequence, players still inhabit Jason’s body rather than Tommy
Vercetti’s. I discovered this GTA 6 easter egg about 3 days ago, here it is in
video form, I think I'm the first person to ever crack this code in the world so
enjoy! - Memeio Sources: GTA 6: Full Vice City retro easter egg walkthrough, all

items.title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit
from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made
World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended. World Buffs are powerful
stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain
events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the
Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all
players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when
players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest. Now
that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs
are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee
haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those
are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP. Unfortunately, players haven't
been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be
lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a
dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be
removed. That has finally been fixed in the latest update, so players can now
enter dungeons with World Buffs to help maximize their damage and health. This
should be particularly useful for doing dungeons at a slightly lower level than
is intended, as the extra HP and melee haste is definitely noticable. Blizzard
clarified in the patch notes that World Buffs will still be removed when
entering raids, so players won't be able to stack as many World Buffs as
possible before raid night, as was the case in previous versions of classic
WoW.  Other changes found in the patch notes include a fix for an Uldaman boss
that players were exploiting to make fast gold. Another is a fix for "a few
spells and abilities" that were causing more weapon-proc effects than intended,
likely nerfing the DPS of whatever classes were taking advantage of the bug. You
can read the full patch notes below. Blizzard recently outlined in the latest
episode of the WoW: Forever podcast how it wants to get rid of the idea of
"best-in-slot gear," as well as how the game's has overhauled old-school WoW's
player-vs.-player systems. In other Forever news, the game's launch has seen
more than 15 million characters created so far, with the highest weekly player
numbers for WoW in 15 years.  WoW: Forever November 23 Hotfix Patch Notes
Classes Druid The 4-piece Feralheart set for Druids now correctly grants 4
Energy regeneration every 1 second for 5 seconds. Priest Mind Vision should no
longer proc effects. Shadow Fixed an issue where Dark Inspiration was not
granting the correct amount of %Spirit increase if Mind Flay was used to
activate it. Fixed an issue where Chastise was not usable in Shadowform. Warlock
Destruction Fixed an issue where Intensity was not working on Incinerate.
Warrior Fixed an issue where players could have and use Mortal Strike from their
spellbook, even without the Mortal Strike talent. This does not remove it from
their spellbook but prevents it from being used without the talent point spent.
Dungeons Uldaman The Obsidian Sentinel drops loot as intended. Items The
Filcher’s Cowl no longer has a level requirement. Professions Cooking Boiled
Clams, Clam Chowder, Goblin Deviled Clams, Giant Clam Scorcho, Undermine Clam
Chowder, and Clam Linguine each now offer the correct Well Fed bonuses and have
been recategorized in the recipe list under “Stamina Food”. Murloc Fin Soup has
had its recovery and Well-Fed amounts increased to the next tier of food,
bringing it closer to other food of that level. Engineering Fixed a bug that
caused Goblin Engineer’s Renewal Gift and Gnome Engineer’s Renewal Gift to
appear as broken, unusable question marks in the inventory. Fixed a bug that
prevented “The Mortar: Reloaded” recipe from being learned upon learning the
“Goblin Mortar” recipe. Leatherworking Fixed a bug that prevented Pattern:
Centaur Hoofwarmers from being learnable. Quests Riverglades - Dunston Willis
once again runs near the end of the escort “Dunston Checks Out.” Wetlands -
After further study, the quest “For Further Study” now has rewards. Wetlands -
The quest “Uncovering the Past” now rewards Ironforge reputation. Wetlands - The
quest “Gleaning Our Future” now rewards Ironforge reputation. Races Fixed an
issue where Wisp Form could be applied to players while they were alive. Spells
Fixed an issue where a few spells and abilities were causing more weapon procs
than intended. Fixed an issue where World Buffs would fall off when changing
areas. They will still fall off when entering raid instances. Fixed an issue
where Fengus’ Ferocity was granting twice as much Spell Power as intended. Fixed
an issue where Darkmoon Faire buffs were granting twice as much power as
intended.

items.title: LEGO reveals Marvel Rivals’ Jeff the Land Shark set for January 1
items.description:
LEGO has revealed its first set based on Marvel Rivals, a 495-piece model of
Jeff the Land Shark priced at $49.99 and scheduled for release on January 1,
2027. The figure measures 5 inches tall and 8.5 inches long, is recommended for
ages 12 and up, and is available to preorder through LEGO’s website. The set
turns the game’s shark character into a poseable model that builders can arrange
in different stances. Its reveal follows an earlier leak that divided fans: some
liked the character’s cheerful look, while others felt the build did not capture
his rounded, soft appearance. LEGO Marvel design lead Jesper C. Nielsen said the
team wanted the model to reflect both Jeff’s playful appeal and his role in
battles. Highlights: Playable details: Builders can remove Jeff’s back fin to
represent his hide-and-seek movement ability or remove his tongue to close his
mouth. Game roster: Marvel Rivals has 55 playable characters and was in its 11th
season when GameRant published its report. Sources: Lego Jeff the Land Shark

items.title: Witcher 4 Has Fewer People Working On It Than It Did 3 Months Ago, But Just Barely
items.description:
As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed
new information about its projects and headcount. For the quarter that ended on
October 31, The Witcher 4 was the company's biggest project by headcount, with
513 people working on it. That's down from 519 people for the quarter that ended
on July 31. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54dabgZJ5YA&rco=1 For comparison,
the number of developers on Cyberpunk 2 rose from 184 to 199 and staffers on the
new IP codenamed Hadar jumped from 33 to 34. The codename Sirius game, believed
to be a multiplayer The Witcher game, saw its development staff shrink from 84
to 60; the project has undergone numerous shifts throughout its development as
CD Projekt reworks the experience. CD Projekt's total development headcount rose
from 1,045 to 1,051. CD Projekt's overall development headcount rose to 1,051
people. In terms of money, CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN
($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD
Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development
costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31
million PLN ($7.6 million USD). CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the
works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in
2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet.
The company is also working on a game with Scopely, the mobile gaming giant
owned by Saudi Arabia. Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's
creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Giving Pornhub A Hard Time
items.description:
Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms
of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive
open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking
start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the
"biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4
hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a
quick browse of after-hours material. According to Mashable, US traffic on
Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by
traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically,
Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely
indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to
fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i7l7Lu69V_c Thanks to the game's massive
success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research
noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries
were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip
club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The
fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search
results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low. Thursday Night
Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season
so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed
entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the
football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the
box office, as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120
million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad
of Songbirds and Snakes. For more GTA 6 news, you can read up on how modders are
attempting to make an unofficial PC port, how to fix GTA 6's broken HDR, and you
can check out our list of walkthroughs in the GTA 6 guides hub.

items.title: Thursday Night Football Had Lowest Viewership All Season On GTA 6 Launch Day
items.description:
The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out,
had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the
low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6. The data shows
that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between
the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide
from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New
England Patriots and New York Jets. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dJDf76QVv70
Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the
Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers, and was up
17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and
Denver Broncos. Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the
full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per
game. One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be
too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low
ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to
competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because
it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by
a score of 26-3. The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine
more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly
thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to. Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people
also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on
November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up
massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations. GTA 6 sold 32.5
million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day
one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales
when the PC edition arrives in 2027, as rumored. If you're just getting started,
be sure to check out GameSpot's rundown of the five best things to do first and
our guide for how to make money fast.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 opens North America-Europe travel ahead of Evercold
items.description:
Square Enix will temporarily let Final Fantasy 14 players travel between North
American and European data centers starting December 1, giving them another
option when login queues grow during the launch of Patch 8.0. North American and
European players can also visit Oceanian data centers, while Japanese players
can travel to Oceania. The change aims to spread demand because peak play times
differ by region. Players may face higher latency when connecting to distant
servers, and Square Enix recommends testing the feature before the expansion
arrives. The studio says it will consider making cross-region travel permanent
and extending it to other regions after gathering player feedback. Final Fantasy
14: Evercold launches February 23, 2027, with early access beginning February 19
for eligible purchasers. Highlights: Play together: Cross-region travel lets
players take their existing characters to friends’ data centers for quests and
raids, rather than creating alternate characters there. Oceania limits: Oceanian
players can receive visitors from North America, Europe and Japan, but cannot
travel to other regions under the announced arrangement. Same-region matching:
Player matching across data centers within the same region rolled out in Japan
with patch 7.57, then in Europe and North America with patch 7.58. Perspectives:
Some European Final Fantasy 14 players: Players commenting on the change warned
that cross-region travel could draw people away from European party-finder
groups and reduce activity in their region. (GamesRadar+) Some Oceanian players:
An Oceanian player welcomed the expanded access for others but said it would be
useful for Oceanian players to visit other regions when their own is quiet.
(GamesRadar+) Sources: Final Fantasy 14 is finally opening up cross-region
server travel ahead of Patch 8.0 - pcgamesn.com Final Fantasy 14 party finder
chaos to hit an all-time high as devs prepare to "open travel" between NA and
Europe servers - gamesradar.com More FFXIV Cross-Region Data Center Travel
Options Announced - siliconera.com Final Fantasy 14 Is Letting Players Travel
Between North American And European Servers For The First Time In 16 Years And
Fans Are Psyched - kotaku.com US and EU players will be able to play together in
Final Fantasy 14 soon, with Square Enix considering 'the possibility of
permanently enabling travel' in the future - pcgamer.com

items.title: GTA 6 Has A Secret Mission That Feels Like Hard Target Meets Saw
items.description:
In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6, you can teach one loud-mouthed
hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will
require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and
the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most
elusive of quarry. Go to Hyde Island Located north of Lummox County and the
Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to
do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock
you out. Listen to your captor's speech Now for the boring part. You'll wake up
inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in
place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to
move. Run to the tent directly in front of you You'll have 10 seconds to reach a
tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the
sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll
be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll
track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two
bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for
his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers. Search for more outposts You can find
more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so
be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be
tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that
can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you. Prepare for a showdown
Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The
hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a
red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so
once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he
stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off. Collect your rewards
Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper
rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items
and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work. What happens if
you fail? If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up
near one of your safehouses. The good news is you can retry the mission by
heading back to Hyde Island, but the bad news is you'll have to listen to the
hunter's speech again. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to
finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered
with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub. This is constantly updated, with
walkthroughs on how to play GTA 6 on your phone, how to unlock hurricanes, and
how to go to hell for a fight against Satan himself.

stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off.


COLLECT YOUR REWARDS

Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper
rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items
and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work.


WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU FAIL?

[https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-9.jpg?w=636]

If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up near one of
your safehouses. The good news is you can retry the mission by heading back to
Hyde Island, but the bad news is you'll have to listen to the hunter's speech
again.

For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on
the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6
guides hub.
[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-guides-hub-how-to-do-everything-in-grand-theft-auto-6/]
This is constantly updated, with walkthroughs on how to play GTA 6 on your phone
[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/how-to-play-gta-6-on-your-pc-or-phone-via-remote-play-on-xbox/],
how to unlock hurricanes
[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/how-to-unlock-hurricanes-in-gta-6/], and how
to go to hell
[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-how-to-go-to-hell-and-fight-satan/] for
a fight against Satan himself.

items.title: GTA 6 Players On PS5 Averaged 17+ Hours During First Weekend
items.description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's breaking records
everywhere, including at PlayStation. The gaming giant has announced that GTA 6
is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes back 30+ years
and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more than 39
million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dJDf76QVv70 Here is a quick rundown of GTA 6's
new records on PS5 so far (covering the November 19-22 period): Highest number
of concurrent players for any free or paid game on PlayStation, ahead of
Fortnite, Call of Duty, and everything else. Players collectively logged 683
million hours of GTA 6 at launch, with each player spending an average of 17.4
hours in the game's first few days. GTA 6's launch led to the largest number of
newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the system came out in 2020,
and outside of the Christmas season. GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of
new PS5 consoles, which suggests a lot of people bought a system specifically
for GTA 6. A big, record-breaking start for GTA 6 was always expected. If the
game didn't break records, that would be a bigger story. Additionally, GTA 6 is
an anomaly--its success will not save the AAA industry from its many serious,
deep-rooted issues, experts have said, and many believe other publishers will
learn all the wrong lessons. GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases
alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to
sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in
2027, as rumored.
items.content:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6

that GTA 6 is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes
back 30+ years and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more
than 39 million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dJDf76QVv70

Here is a quick rundown of GTA 6's new records on PS5 so far (covering the
November 19-22 period):

 * Highest number of concurrent players for any free or paid game on
   PlayStation, ahead of Fortnite, Call of Duty, and everything else.
 * Players collectively logged 683 million hours of GTA 6 at launch, with each
   player spending an average of 17.4 hours in the game's first few days.
 * GTA 6's launch led to the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a
   single day since the system came out in 2020, and outside of the Christmas
   season.
 * GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles, which suggests a
   lot of people bought a system specifically for GTA 6.

A big, record-breaking start for GTA 6 was always expected. If the game didn't
break records, that would be a bigger story. Additionally, GTA 6 is an
anomaly--its success will not save the AAA industry from its many serious,
deep-rooted issues

lessons.
[https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-is-like-the-olympics-a-rare-cultural-moment-with-massive-ripple-effects/?_thumbnail_id=1958726]

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone

items.title: The Reason Behind Pokémon's Mysterious Social Media Countdown Has Been Revealed
items.description:
Update: Brace for disappointment. The Pokémon Company is no stranger to a little
over-hyping every now and then, but its latest bit of marketing has us seriously
thinking that there is a big announcement in the pipeline. You see, TPC is
counting down to... something. As brought to our attention by Serebii's Joe
Merrick, the company has been sharing images on social media of its 30th
anniversary icons, with a number underneath. Interestingly, these numbers
decrease by the number of hours that have passed between each post — 1,025 on
18th October, 843 on 26th, 676 today. Read the full article on nintendolife.com

items.title: Rockstar shops Red Dead screen rights for at least $100 million
items.description:
Rockstar Games is reportedly seeking film or television partners for its Red
Dead Redemption franchise, with a minimum licensing price of more than $100
million, according to a report by The Ankler cited by gaming publications. No
studio has acquired the rights, and neither the format—film or series—nor the
story approach has been decided. The same report says Rockstar has no interest
in adapting Grand Theft Auto (GTA). Commentators have cited Red Dead’s more
linear, story-driven games and connected narrative as reasons it could suit an
adaptation, and GTA’s greater popularity as a possible reason for Rockstar’s
different stance. Rockstar has not publicly commented on the report. Highlights:
Rights benchmark: TheGamer reported an $800 million price tag for a package of
adaptation rights to Xbox’s biggest game franchises, rather than a
single-franchise license. Franchise sales: Take-Two Interactive said Red Dead
Redemption 2 had sold more than 89 million copies and the franchise had passed
118 million worldwide. Launch history: Red Dead Redemption 2 had the
second-biggest entertainment launch at the time, behind GTA 5. Hollywood market:
Recent game adaptations such as Fallout and The Last of Us have succeeded on
streaming, while several other game-based film and television projects are in
development. Sources: Rockstar Is Reportedly Eager To Turn Red Dead Redemption
Into A Movie - thegamer.com Rockstar is reportedly interested in a Red Dead
Redemption film or TV show - videogameschronicle.com Rockstar is actively

items.title: Action RPG Showa American Story delayed to October 28, 2027
items.description:
Developer NEKCOM Games and publisher 4Divinity have delayed the action
role-playing game Showa American Story from 2026 to October 28, 2027, for
PlayStation 5 and PC. The studio says the core game content is complete and it
will use the additional time for polishing and optimization. The game imagines a
United States purchased by Japan during its economic rise and follows Chigusa
Choko, a movie star brought back from the dead. Its Gamescom 2026 demo drew
contrasting reviews: Game Informer praised its offbeat humor and action, while
Rock Paper Shotgun criticized its controls and combat and reported that the
director had heard feedback about how the action feels. Highlights: Setting: Neo
Yokohama occupies the site of former Hollywood Influences: Push Square compared
the quest's feel to Shenmue, Yakuza and No More Heroes Perspectives: Rock Paper
Shotgun reviewer Ashley Schofield said the demo’s challenge came largely from
wrestling with awkward controls and delayed attacks, and described it as a pale
imitation of Like a Dragon. (Rock Paper Shotgun) Sources: One Of Our Favorite

items.description:
Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals, and to celebrate, a
new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot,
Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is
the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027,
priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff
below, showing the completed build alongside his box art. See at The Lego Store
The 495-piece set captures the adorable strategist in all his glory, including
his big eyes, toothy smile, huge tongue, and even his collar. This won't be a
static figure either: once fully assembled, Jeff has a movable head, legs, tail,
and fins that let builders recreate his joyful trot, swimming, and battle poses.
For added touches, his collar includes his signature name tag, his tongue can be
removed to close his mouth, and his fin can be detached so builders can
replicate Jeff's Hide-and-Seek movement ability from the game. "Jeff brings
together everything players love about a breakout gaming character: an
unforgettable silhouette, a personality you understand instantly, and the
ability to turn any match into a story," Lego Marvel design lead Jesper C.
Nielsen said in a press release. "We wanted this Lego model to capture both
sides of him, from the lovable companion fans want beside their screen to the
unpredictable strategist they meet in battle." Meanwhile, Jeff and the rest of
the Marvel Rivals roster are preparing to cap off an entire year of
Avengers-centric events that have been building up to the game's big Avengers:
Doomsday tie-in. Season 11.5 kicks off on December 11. Nightcrawler was recently
added to the game, bringing mutant energy, swords, and teleportation strategies,
and he'll soon be followed by Marvel's unique take on Dracula, who has spent the
last few months hibernating and healing for the battles ahead.

items.title: Mini Review: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! (Switch 2) - A Satisfying, Tactile Cooking Sim
items.description:
Order up! I have a real soft spot for games that simulate cooking. A strange
thing given my aversion to crafting mechanics, but cooking? I could do that all
day. KuloNiku: Bowl Up! Is right up my alley, then. Developed by Gamebir Studio,
it sees you take on the role of a new meatball restaurant owner. Your job is to
pay close attention to your customers’ orders to ensure maximum satisfaction,
thus increasing your reputation and revenue. Read the full article on
nintendolife.com

items.title: How To Play GTA 6 On Your PC Or Phone Via Remote Play On Xbox
items.description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming, and
Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you
can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally. Remote
Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbox Series X|S to
a device you might already have, and it's easy to get working. From your
console, select Settings then Devices & connections then Remote features. From
there, check the box for Enable remote features. Xbox Remote Play also has a
"test" feature so you can preview the experience in your home environment before
going further. From there, you can play GTA 6 from a mobile device by accessing
the Xbox Remote Play website, selecting the console you want to connect to, and
then the device. To play GTA 6 on your PC or Xbox Rog Ally, users can open the
Xbox app for PC, click on their profile, then select Accessories & Remote Play
and then select Remote Play to choose the device to play on. Additionally,
people have spotted that GTA 6's store page on the PlayStation Store now
mentions that Remote Play is supported and that PlayStation 5 and PlayStation
Portal owners can use cloud streaming if they have a Premium membership. Right
now, you need a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to stream GTA 6, but some are dreaming of
the day when you can simply stream the game to your PC or phone without any
expensive hardware. That day may eventually come for GTA 6, as Take-Two's own
CEO has said the rising cost of gaming hardware is not a good thing and that
streaming games could be a big business very soon. “If you believe in streaming,
and to be clear, we really do, and I’m happy to put a timeline on it. I think
we’ll be in commercial streaming mode within three years, and by commercial, I
mean low latency," Strauss Zelnick said. "That can 10x the effective installed
base. Now, it doesn’t mean we’re going to 10x our revenue–and we wouldn’t
project that we would–but because obviously your avid consumers already had
access to video game machines. But I do think it creates great opportunity for
titles that are broadly desirable, even outside of core markets.” GTA 6 is doing
just fine without the potential expanded reach of streaming. After all, the game
sold 32.5 million copies before launch and generated close to $4 billion in
revenue by day one. Even if GTA 6 doesn't add support for full streaming without
a console, the game is expected to expand its reach in a major way in 2027 with
an expected PC release. Beyond that, GTA 6 is reportedly going to add an online
mode in 2027 as well, and it could be bigger than Fortnite.

items.title: GTA 6: How To Go To Hell And Fight Satan
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 gets downright weird when you go off the beaten track, and
one secret mission will see you travel to the bowels of hell to fight Beezleboss
himself, Satan. This detour is worth it because you'll get cool cosmetics and a
powerful shotgun, plus a nice little bump to your health. Here's how you can
start this Doom-inspired mission in GTA 6. How to go to Hell in GTA 6 You can
find this mission in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, and it's generally recommended
that you tackle it once you've gotten your bearings in Chapter 2 of GTA 6. You
can access it with either Jason or Lucia, and you'll need to follow these steps
to find it: https://youtu.be/Y3tU0mXzto0 Start the mission at night, preferably
around midnight. Go to the northern section of Port Gellhorn (as indicated on
the maps) and look for the Circles of Hell, a house with an open garage. Inside
the garage, you'll find two NPCs rocking out. Press L2 to highlight them and
start talking. Select the dialogue options "Having fun?" and "It's good" when
prompted. Follow the NPCs into a van that appears shortly afterward, and get
inside. After being transported to the camping grounds, press L2 to stare into
the campfire. Once you've done all that, you'll be taken to Hell, and you'll
have to face off against an army of demons. Don't worry! You'll be equipped with
a powerful shotgun, so you can mow down the demons and fight your way to Satan.
The Prince of Darkness will occasionally summon reinforcements to defend him,
but the denizens of hell are no match for a few well-placed shotgun rounds.
Finish off the devils, and you'll wake up at the campsite. For your efforts,
you'll be rewarded with the following items and upgrades: Circles of Hell top
New tattoo design Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun (collect it next to the throne)
Permanent health boost For a closer look at GTA 6's supernatural side, check out
how to encounter an unkillable NPC, solve the Bigfoot mystery, and help out some
friendly aliens. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a
tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our
Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

items.title: Xbox Project Helix Was Reportedly Designed To Make Online Multiplayer Free
items.description:
For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go
online. From Xbox Live to Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft paywalled multiplayer on its
platforms, but the company reportedly aimed to break down that barrier for its
next-gen console, Project Helix. According to Windows Central, Project Helix was
conceived under the previous Xbox leadership team as the device that would
bridge the divide between PC and console gaming. Like the Asus Xbox ROG Ally PC
handhelds, the console is said to have an Xbox-inspired interface and full PC
game support through storefronts like Steam. Because of that design decision,
it's claimed it didn't make sense to continue with paid multiplayer, since that
service is free for games purchased on PC platforms like Steam and the Epic
Games Store. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7H6YGeREMgY&t=159s As the Windows
Central report noted, that was reportedly the plan before Xbox leadership was
shaken up and gaming hardware prices rose during the AI boom. With Asha Sharma
now in charge of Xbox, the gaming division is more focused on profitability, and
Microsoft's gaming arm has seen sweeping changes. Mass layoffs and studio
divestitures occurred throughout 2026, and Project Helix could be a very
expensive family of devices. If Microsoft ditches paid multiplayer, it loses a
revenue stream for its next-gen push at a time when component prices have risen
steeply. As part of its 25th anniversary celebrations, Microsoft also teased a
few more details about Project Helix, calling it specifically "a console" that
plays games from your PC, not "a PC that can also play console games." "When we
think about Project Helix, it’s really designed to be the ultimate gaming
machine--one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically
existed," VP of next-gen Jason Ronald said.

items.title: Nioh 3 gets final DLC in December, makes Xbox debut in January
items.description:
Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja will release Nioh 3’s final expansion, Bloody
Insurrection, on December 17. The game will debut on Xbox Series X|S on January
28, 2027, alongside a Complete Edition for PlayStation 5, PC and Xbox. The
Complete Edition includes the base game and both story expansions, giving Xbox
players their first chance to play the series. Bloody Insurrection concludes
protagonist Takechiyo’s story with a new stage set in Shimabara in 1638
featuring rebels, alchemists and yokai. It also adds new combat abilities and a
Battlefield of Carnage endgame mode in which players progress through
enemy-filled battlefields and boss fights. Highlights: Endgame challenge:
Battlefield of Carnage spans 100 floors; players gain battlefield effects by
defeating bosses and can combine those bonuses as they advance. New difficulty:
Nioh’s Journey unlocks only after players complete the third playthrough,
Enlightened One’s Journey, and adds Ethereal equipment drops. Combat additions:
The expansion adds weapon-specific Martial Arts, Transformed Arts, Ninjutsu,
Onmyo Magic, Summoning Seals and new Guardian Spirits. New Soul Cores: Bloody
Insurrection adds Yatsu-no-Kami, Nue and Tsuchigumo Soul Cores. Perspectives:
Team Ninja and Koei Tecmo: The companies said Xbox fan response to Ninja Gaiden
4 and the approaching 10th anniversary made this the right time to bring Nioh to
Xbox. (Xbox Wire) Sources: Nioh 3 getting its second DLC next month, and the
action series is finally coming to Xbox in January - gamesradar.com Nioh 3 Comes

items.title: Call of Duty daily players fall 42% as GTA 6 launches
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6’s Nov. 19 launch coincided with a 42% drop in Call of Duty
HQ’s daily active users, from an average of 7.5 million to 4.4 million across
PlayStation, Xbox and Steam, according to estimates from Alinea Analytics. Four
days later, Call of Duty remained 41% below its baseline, while its player count
on PlayStation, its largest platform, had fallen 44%. The figures are
third-party estimates, not official player counts. Alinea also estimated that
Fortnite’s daily console users fell 28%, from 17.8 million to 12.8 million,
before recovering to 19% below its usual level by the weekend. EA Sports FC 27
dropped about 27% but rebounded faster. The estimates cover GTA 6’s
single-player launch. Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea Analytics,
expects its eventual online mode and PC release, both anticipated next year, to
further test rival live-service games, though the PC release date is
unconfirmed. Highlights: Player overlap: Alinea estimates that 29% of GTA 6
players had also played Fortnite that month, compared with 16% who had played
Call of Duty HQ and 11% who had played FC 27. Other releases: FC 27’s daily
users fell from 5.9 million to 4.3 million, then recovered to within 20% of its
baseline; a 50% price cut was cited as one factor in the recovery. Estimate
limits: Alinea did not publish its precise baseline period, and its figures
exclude PC players on Battle.net; Modern Warfare 4 had launched 27 days before
GTA 6. Next event: Fortnite has a season-ending live event scheduled for Dec. 5,
which Elliott said Epic hopes will bring players back. Call of Duty is "the
outlier here", he added, "and Xbox should - candidly - be worried about one of
its premier franchises". - Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea
Analytics Perspectives: Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea
Analytics: Elliott attributed the faster recoveries of Fortnite and FC 27 to
players’ “ingrained habits”. (Eurogamer) Tyler Bahl, Activision chief marketing
officer: In an October interview, Bahl argued that GTA 6 could help Call of Duty
by bringing lapsed players back to their consoles and said a decline in players
on Nov. 19 was not certain. (ARY News) Sources: GTA 6 "hit Call of Duty HARD,"
analyst reports, with a 42% drop in daily players - gamesradar.com GTA 6 Hits
Call of Duty and Fortnite Player Numbers Hard, Making Eventual Online Launch
Scarier - gamewatcher.com ‘Call of Duty’ And ‘Fortnite’ Engagement Plunges After
‘GTA VI’ Release, Report Says - forbes.com GTA 6 launch knocked Call of Duty's
daily players down 42 percent, Alinea estimates - eurogamer.net Analyst
estimates Call of Duty lost 44% of its players when GTA 6 came out, and unlike
fans of its live-service competitors they've been slow to come back -
pcgamer.com GTA 6 launch cuts Call of Duty daily active users by 42 percent -
arynews.tv People are hitting pause on Call of Duty to play GTA 6 instead -

items.title: GTA 6 modders push ahead as teenage port leader quits
items.description:
PC players still have no verified, stable fan-made way to play Grand Theft Auto
VI, but other modding teams report progress beyond boot screens after the
best-known effort, Project Leonida, folded. Its 15-year-old organizer, NotRexed,
said he was stepping away, citing the takedown alongside the strain of school,
sports and complaints from adult users. Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games’
parent company, used a copyright notice to remove Leonida and 3,007 GitHub
repositories containing copies of its code. The company argued that the
project’s “bring your own files” rule still facilitated the use of leaked game
files. Other teams say they have reached early gameplay, but their projects
remain far from finished PC versions: one reportedly ran at about four frames
per second, without textures or lighting, though it allowed movement and
interactions with nonplayer characters. Teams are using AI coding tools to speed
up their work, but Rockstar has not announced a PC release; a first-quarter 2027
launch remains a reported possibility, not a confirmed date. Highlights: More
teams active: PortWatch VI was monitoring 30 projects and scanning online
activity every three hours; its progress percentages are milestone-based and
depend on project reports. Console frame rates: An Xbox glitch reportedly
unlocks a 40-fps mode, while PS5 video-enhancement workarounds add latency
through frame generation or remote streaming. Scam warnings: PC Gamer cautioned
that downloading pirated game files can be illegal and expose PCs to malware,
while a separate report warned of fake PC installers. Perspectives: Cyberleek,
game leaker: Cyberleek described the release of the leaked executable as support
for open-source recompilation and emulation, and defended cryptocurrency
donations as a way to transfer funds without revealing identities. (Rock Paper
Shotgun) Chasm Server moderators: After takedowns hit other port-related
communities, moderator Freakman said the group had no connection to Cyberleek
and that members were keeping a low profile. (Decrypt) Sources: GTA 6 Hacker

   milestone-based and depend on project reports.
 * Console frame rates: An Xbox glitch reportedly unlocks a 40-fps mode, while
   PS5 video-enhancement workarounds add latency through frame generation or
   remote streaming.
 * Scam warnings: PC Gamer cautioned that downloading pirated game files can be
   illegal and expose PCs to malware, while a separate report warned of fake PC

PERSPECTIVES:

   moderator Freakman said the group had no connection to Cyberleek and that

items.title: Tiny Bookshop Sells 1 Million Copies, New DLC Expansion Announced
items.description:
Launching next month. Tiny Bookshop, the charming indie title in which you take
on the role of bookseller in a quaint seaside resort, has officially sold
surpassed 1 million copies sold across PC, Switch, PS5, Xbox, iOS, and Android
since its launch in August 2025. To celebrate, publisher Skystone Games and
developer neoludic have announced a new DLC expansion launching on 5th December
2026: Arts & Crafts. Read the full article on nintendolife.com
items.content:
Launching next month.

Tiny Bookshop [https://www.nintendolife.com/games/switch-eshop/tiny_bookshop],
the charming indie title in which you take on the role of bookseller in a quaint
seaside resort, has officially sold surpassed 1 million copies sold across PC,
Switch, PS5, Xbox, iOS, and Android since its launch in August 2025.

To celebrate, publisher Skystone Games and developer neoludic have announced a
new DLC expansion launching on 5th December 2026: Arts & Crafts.

Read the full article on nintendolife.com
[https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/tiny-bookshop-sells-1-million-copies-new-dlc-expansion-announced]

items.title: Sony highlights Rockstar partnership, Miami event and limited-edition GTA 6 hardware

back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI

items.title: Might and Magic meets, er, paper in sunny new RPG Rise of Furax, a turn-based island tale that is entirely drawn by hand
items.description:
Literal decades ago, I tried to make a first-person RPG in HyperCard. I got as
far as a fateful town gate confrontation before hitting the cap on slides for
the shareware version. I mention this because new, 100% "hand-drawn"
first-person dungeon crawler Rise of Furax is uncannily redolent of my long-lost
HyperCard game. This risks being a) a terrible indictment of the game's visual
direction, and b) an insinuation that developers Rap2h are dastardly rip-off
artists, so let me elaborate that c) I think Rise of Furax looks far, far
lovelier than my lousy primordial hypermedia confection and d) it is a legally
distinct creation. That unfinished HyperCard concept never left the confines of
a Macintosh Performa that is even now rusting on a riverbed. If only I'd pitched
it somewhere, I'd probably be a MILLIONAIRE by now. A million pounds is still a
lot of money, right? Anyway, here's a teaser video for Rise of Furax. Read more

items.title: Nightdive's Thief remaster will make the most "infamous" Thief Gold level a little less maddening, by "just kind of pointing the player in the right direction"
items.description:
1999's Thief Gold is widely considered the definitive incarnation of Thief: The
Dark Project, adding three levels to the Looking Glass stealth sim while tidying
up some bugs, but it has one grievous failing, in the eyes of many: the
notorious Thieves Guild. In this all-new sixth mission, master catburglar
Garrett must infiltrate the lair of a gang of pickpockets, after they filch a
vase he had his eye on. The lair in question is actually very believable, as a
hideout for criminals, in that it resists exploration even with a paper map. It
consists of sunken, samey, obtusely arranged rooms that are made all the more
headache-inducing by objectives that require a lot of backtracking. In much the
same way that I can admire a finely wrought pair of thumbscrews, I think the
Thieves Guild is a clever creation, one that arguably shines when you use every
ability or tactic in Garrett's possession rather than trying to ghost it. But it
very easily becomes frustrating, to the point that many grizzled housebreakers
advise new players to skip the level entirely. The Thieves Guild should be less
frustrating in Nightdive's forthcoming Thief: The Dark Project Remastered,
thanks to a more revealing spread of environmental textures and various other,
furtive adjustments. As with many mods or remasters that speak of boosting the
"immersion", I do worry that something valuable is being sacrificed in the
process. Read more

items.title: Queen's Domain review
items.description:
Where to start with Queen's Domain? It's tempting to begin with King's Field;
after all, FromSoftware's seminal first-person action-RPG is an explicit
inspiration for developer Freshly Baked Games. But 40 hours later, it feels like
so much more. It's equally tempting to invoke another FromSoftware game: Dark
Souls. Queen's Domain owes an obvious debt to that game's celebrated level
design: the dazzling interconnectedness of its vertiginous world. But that's not
quite right either. The deeper you delve, the more there's something of the
spirit of The Legend of Zelda, a touch of Metroidvania too. Until finally you
concede that Queen's Domain, with its remarkable world of densely packed
secrets, is very much its own. Read more

items.title: I've never known a moment like this in video games
items.description:
It was hard not to spend the first hour or so of Grand Theft Auto 6's launch day
in a kind of stun-lock. As far as video games editorial goes - which is not that
far, in fairness; prepare for an over-flattering analogy - the effect was
roughly the equivalent of Tom Hanks' experience, as his John H. Miller first set
foot on Omaha beach. Tweets and reels whistled overhead, news leads stung the
ears, exploding search terms blew apart some poor guides team ally on one side,
while new discoveries in the early game - made by the millions and millions of
launch-day players all picking it apart at once - appeared by surprise like some
flanking ambush on the other. Read more

items.title: Vote now for 2026's RPS 100: Reader Edition
items.description:
For the past six years, the team at RPS have got together to pick what we
consider to be the best 100 games you can play on PC. There's very little
science involved, and we try not to get too hung up on what games should make
the cut. From year to year, our rankings and choices vary wildly as the
formation and tastes of the team changes. However, our definitive list isn't
always met with a chorus of approval and cheers of 'Hear, hear!', "'Well done!',
and 'Couldn't have said it better myself!', so we also have the RPS 100: Reader
Edition. This is your chance to submit your ten favourite PC games of all time.
Your votes will be tallied up with all the other submissions from our other
readers and we will produce a list of the community's top 100. We've just
finished revealing what we currently consider to be the Best PC games of all
time and now it's your turn. Read more

items.title: I completed GTA 6's indie game darling pastiche, Tenebrae Lux, and all I got was this lousy sense of accomplishment
items.description:
"We are but Promethean wanderers on the fringes of oblivion, clinging to a
semblance of light amidst the vast abyss of our own ignorance. Voyaging
uncharted waters may appear foolish to some, yet folly and heroism can often
appear the same to the undiscerning eye," so says the voice of Johannes Zuch -
creator, writer, director, composer, and 'perceptual architect' behind Leonida's
latest favourite indie darling art game, Tenebrae Lux. It's pretentious, it's
deeply up its own arse, and it's awkward and off-putting to play. A must-review

items.title: How the EU's Digital Fairness Act will impact game design, and why it hits European indies particularly hard
items.description:
The European Commission's publication of its draft Digital Fairness Act (DFA)
last week prompted uproar within the games industry, with many notable voices
candidly expressing their concerns. Opinions in the wider industry were more
measured, possibly because some of the practices targeted by the DFA – such as
loot boxes or pay-to-win – are wildly successful economically, but not uniformly
popular amongst players. Read more

items.title: The creator of E.T. on the Atari 2600 likens the deluge of AI-made games to the glut of poor-quality titles released ahead of the US video game crash of 1983
items.description:
At the DevGAMM Lisbon conference this week, veteran game designer Howard Scott
Warshaw gave a talk called "From Atari to AI". Warshaw was behind a number of
famous titles for the Atari 2600, including the classic Yars' Revenge, but
infamously he also designed the game E.T. the Extra-Terrestial, the poor quality
of which has been cited as a factor in the US video game crash of 1983, when US
games industry revenue plummeted from over $3 billion in 1983 to around $100
million in 1985. Read more

items.title: Valve are pausing Steam Machine 2TB orders over "supply constraints," though the 512GB model is free of its waitlist
items.description:
Valve giveth, and Valve taketh away in their latest Steam Machine availability
update. The dinky SteamOS PC continues to have a terrible time with AI
industry-inflicted hardware parts shortages, which at least for its flagship 2TB
model, have become such a problem that Valve are suspending new orders until
further notice. While Valve's post says that they "have wrapped up sending
purchase invites out to all remaining 2TB reservation holders" – meaning if
you'd previously reserved one, you'll still get your chance to buy – "supply
restraints" have put the kibosh on any new orders for now. Read more

items.title: Remembering the back alley brawls of The Warriors, a Rockstar city game that isn't an open world
items.description:
The older I get, the more fascinated I somehow become by how videogames depict
night, how particular technologies at particular times give rise to particular
nightlives. I've already gushed about the Starlight Zone in Sonic the Hedgehog –
the mild dissociation incubated by the soft, ceaseless glare of the construction
yard, the eyeless brick at the level's nadir, the sleepless glitter of the
skyline. Now, let me wind the clock forward, and backward, to Rockstar Toronto's
The Warriors. One long night from the late '70s, sweaty and electric and
menacing, fed through dank and sullen polygons from 2005. Probably the best move
Rockstar made with their adaptation of Walter Hill's film is to retain the
element of phantasmagoria. Both the game and the movie open with a view of Coney
Island's Wonder Wheel, its neon lamps forming a floating tracery of Morse code,
cabins swinging almost imperceptibly against solid darkness. This is a kind of
night in which light is more emblem than illumination, refusing to travel far,
clinging to its source like a frightened ghost. Read more
items.content:
[https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/thewarriors3.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&auto=webp]

Your next gaming monitor should be an OLED display. There, I've said it. And I
know the notion won't please everyone. After all, a large grey proboscidean
lumbers into the room whenever OLED technology is mentioned. Put simply, almost
any risk of the dreaded burn-in is an immediate deal-breaker for some. I do get
that. Likewise, despite my musings just the other day on how affordable gaming
monitors have generally become and the fact you can now snag an OLED panel,
specifically, for sub £300 / $300, it's a stretch to say OLED gaming comes
cheap. And yet here I am arguing firmly in favour of OLED. Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever isn't mere nostalgia bait - it's rebuilding the MMO social architecture that Blizzard spent years dismantling
items.description:
I don't play video games regularly anymore. Not because I've lost interest in
them, but because I no longer make the time, the premium on which has seemed to
exponentiate with age. I realised, however, in 2019 that I was a kind of sleeper
agent: whenever I heard the opening notes of Legends of Azeroth, the original
World of Warcraft login screen music, I would feel the reactivation of a latent
part of my mind laid down when I was 10 years old. And so, like a form of
possession, whenever Blizzard announces a new legacy iteration of the original
WoW, no downpayment in time nor money is too great to prevent me from returning.
Here I am, then, at the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever, seven years after
Blizzard first revived the original 2004 game with World of Warcraft Classic in
2019. Once more I set foot on Durotar, to spend as much time as I can levelling
up a new Orc Warrior before I am forcibly unplugged by either my boss or, more
likely, my wife, and so far it's been a welcome return to some of the frictional
- but more involving and consequential - socialising that WoW's decades of
updates had previously sanded down. Read more

items.title: Korridor turns those Youtube ads for vertical mobile shooters into a new, "deeply strategic" genre, and I can't decide if it's lying
items.description:
I like to think I'm difficult to hypnotise, but I confess, I'm a sucker for
those Youtube adverts for the mobile vertical shooters. You know the ones:
boglins pour towards an auto-firing player, who must dodge about to grab
upgrades while whittling down the horde. The player in the advert always does
pretty well for 20 seconds, but ahhhh, then they get just a tiny bit
overconfident, mistime how long it'll take them to erode the health of an ogre
midboss, and: bam! Show me one of those ads, and I'll always watch to the end in
the hope that this time, the protagonist will Study The Blade, conquer their
harmatia, and slay the damn ogre. I've never actually played any of the mobile
shooters in question, mind you. I'm far too cultured for that, you dope! Except
that I've just been playing the demo for Korridor, which is supposedly "based
off" of the ads, but might as well be one of the games they're promoting, for
all I know. Read more

items.title: I have double-checked and yes, original 'GTA killer' Driv3r really was that rubbish
items.description:
At this point the tragedy of Driv3r, or Driver 3, or my personal favourite
Drive-thrur, is well thumbed. A familiar litany of unrealised ambition, heinous
bugs, dull open-world design, and an expensive yet audibly bored voice cast, the
accidental comedic highlight of which is Michelle Rodriguez flatly reeling off
car theft orders from what sounds like the inside of a Michelle Rodriguez-sized
tupperware container. A more widely forgotten detail is that, for a while, there
was a non-zero chance - a belief, even - that Drive Three Er was going to be the
opposite. The 2003-2004 hype cycle had sowed the notion that this would in fact
be the open-world crime thriller to knock Grand Theft Auto off its perch, and
even 22 years before GTA 6's idolising reviews, that was no small promise;
Rockstar were still enjoying the balmy success of Vice City, and we could see
San Andreas cresting the hill on a stolen, shining BMX. "Ah, but did they have
Michael Madsen doing doughnuts in car parks?," publishers Atari asked the world,
either unaware or in denial of the spluttering, clapped-out rattletrap they were
about to wheel into the showroom. You likely know the rest, though one of the
dangers of familiarity is the subsequent breeding of complacency, which in this
case can manifest as a thawing acceptance. I succumbed to this myself, having
recently installed a legally unlinkable copy of Drivethreeuh, mind opened to the
possibility that maybe it wasn't that bad. Six hours later, I am here to tell
you: it was. Read more

items.title: What would Rockstar have done if GTA hadn't taken off? Former tech director Obbe Vermeij on Scottish zombies, James Bond and the "curse" of success
items.description:
It's bizarre today to think of Rockstar working on games that aren't Grand Theft
Auto. Frankly, it's bizarre to think of Rockstar working on games that aren't
GTA 6, which rolls onto console hard drives this week. A decade in the making,
with a development team of thousands scattered across an international network
of studios, GTA 6 aims to be the Maximum Game. It's both a dense, lively open
world and a monument to the exhausting impersonality of "triple-A" game
productions. It contains multitudes: birdlife! Realistic cloud formation! Fuel
mechanics! Romance! Soda visibly sloshing around in bottles! It's an imperial
production shadowed by labour disputes, that appears to have given Rockstar's
various teams little time or space to think about anything else. It wasn't ever
thus. Once upon a time, Rockstar weren't just known for GTA and to a
considerably lesser extent, Red Dead Redemption. Once upon a time, they had a
reputation for slightly dodgy experiments. I recently interviewed former
Rockstar North tech director Obbe Vermeij about a few of them, including Agent,
the unofficial James Bond game Rockstar toyed with before putting all chips on
Grand Theft Auto 5. Read more

items.title: "Games are best made by people": The IWGB and other European unions publish joint manifesto calling on workers, employers and consumers to reject genAI
items.description:
As part of a summit meeting in Manchester yesterday, the IWGB Game Workers union
have joined up with other unions spanning the Republic of Ireland's GWUI,
Germany's GDRT, Italy's FIOM-CGIL, France's STJV, and Spain's CSVI to publish a
manifesto that aims to "bring to light the risks and dangers genAI poses to the
workforce" for consumers, workers and publishers alike. The manifesto states
that "GenAI is currently harming the games industry, its workers and the games
they produce," and suggests actions that can be taken by all to reduce harm done
to the industry. The manifesto specifies the "severe harm to the environment,
the destruction of communities and the exploitation of the Global South" as
wider harms of the technology, but maintains its focus on the industry itself.
Read more

Public Investment Fund, is the Unity Fellowship, a grant program that offers

handing out cash. The Unity for Humanity grant, just earlier this year, spread
$600K across ten different indie projects focused on societal and environmental
issues. Read more

items.title: Break up and re-commodify a fallen Earth in Steel Gullet, a satisfyingly funereal factory puzzler that really loves thermodynamics
items.description:
It's amazing what a difference a few lines of preamble can make to your
understanding of a game. Out now on PC, Steel Gullet is a factory engineering
puzzler that, while notable for its meticulous interest in thermodynamics,
broadly compares to the foundational work of Zachtronics, together with more
recent and focussed conveyor belt wranglers such as Modulus. Resources come in,
and you arrange machines on a grid to transform them into something else, before
sliding them into an output hopper. The difference is that you're doing this
inside a huge walking fortress city, which stamps across the surface of a
largely unseen, devastated and uninhabitable Earth. Your resources are the
refuse of a bygone human civilisation: knots of concrete and rebar, flaccid
rubber hose and splintered plank, that must be separated out before you can
manufacture anything. Read more

items.title: Microsoft's SideWinder Strategic Commander was a failed attempt to reimagine RTS controls. 23 years later, why are some players still using it?
items.description:
PC players have been conditioned for decades to accept the keyboard-and-mouse
setup for RTS games. One hand has to handle movement and commands through a
keyboard, while the other points, drags, and selects with a mouse. Peripheral
makers have, usually with the addition of more buttons, made many minor
variations to this time-honored arrangement, but there's only ever been one real
attempt to rethink it entirely for the PC: the Microsoft SideWinder Strategic
Commander. Read more
